question: Who makes African Oils avocado oil?
markdown:
African Oils
avocado oil is made by the South African brand
African Oils
, which cold-presses the oil from the pulp of locally grown South African Hass avocados. They operate out of the Paarden Island area in Cape Town, South Africa.
Product Details
Source Material:
100% pure green pulp of South African Hass avocados (no seeds or chemical additives)
Processing:
Cold-pressed and extra virgin
Available Sizes:
Ranging from 100ml bottles up to bulk 5-liter containers
